title: Fix new-project working_directory rejected (vault-relative /Name)

title: Mocklab/local: settings.snapshot must not hang Skills on Brain RPC timeout
description:

Settings → Skills stuck on "Loading snapshot…" forever on localhost mock stack. Blocks viewing skills entirely.

1. pnpm dev:tmux (BRAIN_RPC_ENABLED=1, mock-gateway)

4. Observe Loading snapshot… for >15s

## Observed
GET /api/settings/snapshot → HTTP 504
{"error":"brain rpc timed out after 10000ms","code":"timeout","retryable":true,"method":"settings.snapshot"}
Mock gateway does not implement settings.snapshot Brain RPC.

## Acceptance
1. Local mocklab stack returns a usable settings snapshot (fixture fallback OR mock-gateway implements settings.snapshot)
2. UI never infinite-spins: show error + retry on 504/timeout
3. Skills table becomes visible with inventory rows in local QA

## Fix options (pick one primary)
A. mock-gateway: handle settings.snapshot with fixture JSON
B. BFF: on Brain RPC timeout for settings.snapshot in development, fall back to fixtures/settings-snapshot.json
C. demo-env: SETTINGS_PREFER_FIXTURE / disable brain path for settings when using mock only
Plus UI: SettingsView error state for snapshot failure

title: epic: chat activity plane — soft doc open, tools, subagents, workflows
description:
Product epic (2026-07-29) after OnlyOffice lp-xcu wave. Soft mode A for document references plus first-class agent activity in chat.

## User goals
1. Soft open: first office path reference in a message opens the document pane (not only open/work verbs).
2. Fix: when pane opens, document content must actually load (preview/OnlyOffice).
3. All backend/Lanyard Agent tool calls render via Astryx ChatToolCalls (status lifecycle).
4. Subagents: active indicators, named + colored icons, click opens activity side pane with roster and drill-in work.
5. Tool completion should reflect subagent done.
6. Workflows: stage expand/collapse, nested subagent activity, inline operate.

## Research synthesis (OI / OpenCode / agent UIs)
- Inline default: collapsed tool rows (verb + target + status); expand for detail.
- Collapse noisy context tools into groups.
- Subagents = first-class navigable sessions/cards (color identity), not buried logs.
- Side pane for deep activity; chat spine stays narrative.
- Parent must show child status (running / needs input / done).

## Existing stack
- @astryxdesign/core ChatToolCalls already used in ChatTimeline (partial tool_progress path).
- Document pane: DocumentPaneHost / PANEL_OPEN (lp-xcu).
- Relay tool_progress + optional portal_event subagent telemetry (read-only today).
- Composer $ workflows / @ agents when host advertises inventory.

## Principles
- Model the domain: ToolCall, SubagentRun, WorkflowRun, ActivityPaneMode.
- Experience first: inspectable agent work without drowning chat.
- Sequence verifiable units: load fix → soft open → tool fidelity → activity pane → subagent → workflow → E2E.
- Boundary discipline: parse agent events at SSE/BFF edge into typed domain.

## Out of scope v1
- Building a new design system; extend Astryx ChatToolCalls + portal hosts.
- Hermes multi-host fleet.
acceptance_criteria:
- Soft-mode office path reference opens document pane with loaded content (preview or OnlyOffice per gates)
- All routed agent tool_progress events render as ChatToolCalls with pending/running/complete/error
- Subagent runs show named colored indicators; click opens activity side pane with roster + drill-in
- Tool/subagent completion states stay consistent
- Workflow runs show stages (expand/collapse) and nested subagents
- Playwright/UI evidence for each phase

title: bug: OnlyOffice mint fails — local multi-root vs Brain RPC vault paths
description:
Live 2026-07-28: vault browser + content work via Brain RPC (relative paths e.g. /Business/.../file.xlsx). POST /api/office/sessions returns missing_file Vault file not found. title: P0 security: make Hermes headless dangerous actions fail closed
description: Hermes dangerous shell approval and execute_code approval return approved in local non-interactive non-gateway contexts. This lets prompt-injected or unattended sessions run host-impacting shell commands or arbitrary Python unless yolo/off is explicit. Fix the approval boundary so dangerous shell and execute_code fail closed when no human approval surface exists, except for explicit trusted modes such as approvals.mode=off, yolo, or a clearly named noninteractive approve setting.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Dangerous command approval denies by default in non-interactive non-gateway contexts.
- [ ] execute_code denies by default on local, SSH, and host-mounted Docker backends without explicit trusted mode.
- [ ] Explicit yolo/off/trusted-noninteractive modes keep intentional behavior and are documented.
- [ ] Existing cron deny behavior remains fail-closed.
- [ ] Tests cover local noninteractive shell, execute_code, gateway approval, interactive approval, yolo/off, and sandboxed backend exceptions.
- [ ] Targeted Hermes approval/code execution tests pass.

close_reason: Hermes headless dangerous shell and execute_code fail closed by default; yolo/off/noninteractive_mode opt-ins documented; 398 approval tests passed; hermes PR #23 + platform PR #139 (docs/pin record).

title: P0 security: prevent vault filesystem symlink breakout
description: The local and multi-root filesystem vault providers use lexical containment checks before stat/readFile. Symlinks inside an allowed vault root can point outside the root and disclose host files. Fix by rejecting symlinks with lstat or by enforcing realpath(root)/realpath(target) containment before list, stat, and read operations. Also add a normal vault read size cap so a huge allowed file cannot exhaust BFF memory. Key files: portal/packages/bff/src/vault/fs-provider.ts and multi-root-fs-provider.ts.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] readFile refuses symlinks that resolve outside the allowed root.
- [ ] listDirectory does not follow or expose outside-root symlink targets as regular files/directories.
- [ ] Multi-root matching uses canonical target containment, not only lexical path prefixes.
- [ ] Normal vault content reads have a documented maximum byte cap or streaming strategy.
- [ ] Regression tests create symlinks inside temp roots pointing outside and prove reads/listing are denied.
- [ ] BFF vault tests and DB-backed vault integration tests pass.
notes:
Implemented realpath containment for FS vault providers. commit=40c9bda4119aa331a5ffb89ca6b6e0604aabecbc. PR=https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/140 (draft). Tests: vault-fs + multi-root unit + vault.integration 15/15 pass with CONTROL_PLANE_DATABASE_URL.

title: P0 security: remove ONLYOFFICE query-controlled script origin
description: The web app lets query parameters enable ONLYOFFICE and choose the Document Server URL. A URL such as ?onlyoffice_editor=1&onlyoffice_ds_url=https://evil.example can cause the app to inject an attacker-controlled api.js script into the portal origin. Fix by removing production query-string and untrusted runtime DS URL overrides, deriving the DS origin from trusted config, validating it against an allowlist, requiring HTTPS outside localhost dev, and adding CSP script-src coverage for approved DS origins. Key files: portal/packages/web/src/features/chat/documentPane/onlyOfficeFeatureFlag.ts, onlyOfficeApiLoader.ts, useOfficeEditorSession.ts.

- [ ] Query parameters cannot enable ONLYOFFICE in production builds.

- [ ] DS origin is parsed and validated against a trusted allowlist before script injection.
- [ ] Remote DS origins require HTTPS; localhost dev remains explicit and test-only.
- [ ] CSP or equivalent deployment config restricts ONLYOFFICE script origins.
- [ ] Tests cover malicious query params, allowed configured DS URL, missing DS URL, and localhost dev behavior.
